editorialNotes.basis: Retain the entire frozen row רב ענן בר יוסף מד׳ תהלים פ״סה־ד. The enlarged primary Hyman tile is compatible with סה and the compact following ד; the old exact-glyph disagreement is preserved in the historical record. Bounded name-led lookup found the same explicit name רב ענן בר יוסף in the named Hebrew OYW digital witness at Midrash Tehillim65:4, which reads רב ענן בר יוסף בשם רב אידי. The fetched OYW chapter68 has three sections, no matching name, and68:4 is empty. This joint primary-scan and exact-name cited-work evidence supports reading the existing citation as chapter65, section4, resolving a substantive numeral hold under the editorial policy without changing the proposed row or normalizing its punctuation. The digital version does not prove every historical edition uses identical numbering, and is not a manuscript witness. This establishes the citation reading only, not an authority identity, family fact or KG join; other list references have not been independently verified.
